title: What share does each child get from 2 cakes among 5 children?
description: Each of the two cakes is cut into five equal pieces and each child takes two pieces, which is two fifths. The share is checked by putting five such shares together to get two cakes.
teaching_notes: One idea: two cakes shared among five children gives two fifths of a cake each, because each cake is cut into five equal pieces. Watch for students who say each child gets two cakes or one fifth.

source: Figure it Out Q3 (section 7.6, second block)
video_script.why: A learner finds the share of cake when two cakes are shared equally among five children in {{NAME_5}}'s group.
video_script.substitution: none: the book's own cakes shared in {{NAME_5}}'s group
video_script.anchor: two cakes on a table and five children in {{NAME_5}}'s group
video_script.payoff_line: Each child gets two fifths of a cake

names.{{NAME_5}}: a child in the group where two cakes are shared among five children

maths_rules: 2 cakes among 5 children: cut each cake into 5 equal pieces, giving 10 pieces
10 pieces among 5 children is 2 pieces each, and one piece is 1/5 of a cake, so each child gets 2/5 of a cake
check: 5 children with 2/5 each is 5 × 2/5 = 2 cakes
video_script.design: One idea: cut every cake into as many pieces as there are children. The two cakes stay on the table and the pieces move to the children.

marks.scene: the title card, the two cakes and the five children appear

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about cakes shared in {{NAME_5}}'s group.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Two cakes are shared equally among five children. What share does each child get?

beats.on_screen: the cakes and the children stay on the board

narration: <bookmark mark='cut'/>When a cake is cut into five equal pieces, each piece is one fifth of the cake.
<bookmark mark='piece'/>Several such pieces together make a bigger share.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, two cakes and five children, with equal shares.

beats.on_screen: To find: the share of each child

marks.find: the question to find is written

marks.cut: each of the two cakes is cut into five equal pieces

narration: <bookmark mark='cut'/>Step one, cut each cake into five equal pieces, because there are five children.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: 10 pieces among 5 children: 2 pieces each, and each piece is 1/5, so 2/5

narration: <bookmark mark='give'/>Step two, share the ten pieces among five children, and each child takes two pieces.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, put the five shares back together. Five times two fifths is two cakes.

marks.pay: the answer is written and boxed

narration: <bookmark mark='pay'/>Each child gets two fifths of a cake.
